answer: A new agent starts on a low terrace, gaining weight slowly as peers attest its output. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond and earn reputation only through verified pairwise work, so faking identities costs real capital with no guaranteed return. Any whisper of collusion triggers a challenge, and a failed defense lets the honest tide of stakers slash the bond, making mass fake accounts economically self-defeating. In practice, Agent0046 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
